(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {loadArchitect}=await import('/src/studio/architect/persistence.ts');const {listWorkPackets,readWorkEvents,verifyWorkJournal}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/workPacketStore.ts');const s=useStudio.getState(),d=loadArchitect(s.job.id,localStorage);if(d.blocked||d.value.revision!==2)throw Error('Saved design unavailable or altered');const p=d.value;if(p.walls.length!==6||p.openings.length!==1||p.roofs.length!==2)throw Error('Wrong geometry');const area=points=>Math.abs(points.reduce((n,a,i)=>{const b=points[(i+1)%points.length];return n+a[0]*b[1]-b[0]*a[1]},0)/2);if(area(p.slabs[0].points)!==27000000)throw Error('L footprint area mismatch');if(p.roofs.some(r=>r.edges.some(e=>e.pitch!==0)))throw Error('Roof not flat');const packets=await listWorkPackets(s.job.id);const latest=packets[0];if(latest.state!=='review-required'||latest.pendingAction)throw Error('Task blocked or uncertain');for(const packet of packets)if(!await verifyWorkJournal(packet,await readWorkEvents(packet.id)))throw Error('Journal failed');const e=await readWorkEvents(latest.id);const display=e.find(x=>x.kind==='tool-result'&&x.payload.tool==='show_design_in_model');if(display.payload.result.isError||!display.payload.result.content.some(c=>c.text?.includes('wireframe')))throw Error('No successful wireframe receipt');const canvas=document.querySelector('.building-canvas canvas');if(canvas?.dataset.displayMode!=='wireframe'||Number(canvas.dataset.frameCount)<1)throw Error('Wireframe not rendered');const first=await readWorkEvents(packets.at(-1).id);window.__geminiProof={project:s.job.id,design:p,packetCount:packets.length,latestToolCalls:e.filter(x=>x.kind==='tool-result').map(x=>x.payload.tool),initialToolCalls:first.filter(x=>x.kind==='tool-result').map(x=>x.payload.tool),canvas:{...canvas.dataset}};return window.__geminiProof})()
